description: Aras Dogan and colleagues at Design and Simulation Technologies publish OpenFOAM case files, scripts and results for four thermal-flow validation problems. They cover transitional room flow, forced convection with two turbulence models, natural convection in a model fire room, and thermal distribution in an open-aisle data centre. The deposit identifies the original experimental references and supplies layout.csv for the data-centre case. Zenodo serves compressed TAR/XZ archives and the layout table under CC BY 4.0, free of charge. Published in February 2022, the collection describes fixed benchmark geometries, not a geographic coverage or a monitoring period; detailed mesh and time-step resolutions remain unknown from the landing page. It can help reproduce cooling-efficiency simulations and compare turbulence assumptions. The archives were not executed. The files run with the software represented by model-openfoam; version compatibility requires checking before reuse.
